afterCorrectionDeterministicControl.commit: ddfcfa037c33c33634a88cf65d8fe841af38bdf6, isolated `git worktree add --detach`, re-verified as part of Stage 2 audit #466's own correction cycle (PR #467, in response to a Stage 1 review finding disputing the 719/718/1 count above)
afterCorrectionDeterministicControl.command: node --test <all 14 tools/review-watch/*.test.mjs and tools/orchestration/*.test.mjs files, enumerated explicitly by name rather than via shell glob expansion>
afterCorrectionDeterministicControl.note: Root cause of the disputed count: the originally-documented command is shell-dependent, not ambiguous in what it counts. `tools/review-watch/*.test.mjs tools/orchestration/*.test.mjs` is expanded into the same 14 explicit filenames by a POSIX shell (bash) before node ever sees it; a non-POSIX shell (PowerShell) does not expand it for a native executable, so the identical literal command fails outright there ('Could not find ...*.test.mjs') rather than falling back to broader test discovery on this Node version. Replacing the glob with the same 14 files enumerated explicitly removes the shell-dependence: run against an isolated worktree at the exact merge commit in both bash and PowerShell, both produced the identical 719/718/1 result, matching the original glob-based bash run and the PR #459 correction commit's own recorded count. The Stage 2 audit's cited 857/857/0 could not be reproduced by the glob-based run, either explicit-enumeration run, or the original correction commit's own count -- four independent data points all agreeing on 719/718/1, none on 857/857/0.

conclusion: 454-B (tools/review-watch/stage1-correction-gate.mjs, 26 new tests per its own test file) and 454-C's wiring into tools/orchestration/next-review-transition-gate.mjs together added 43 net new passing tests (704 - 661) to the combined tools/review-watch + tools/orchestration suite at commit 3750d27, with zero regressions. The subsequent PR #459 Stage 1 correction pass (0a13af0) added 15 further net new passing tests (719 - 704), also with zero regressions, bringing the exact merge commit's total to 719 tests / 718 pass / 1 fail. The sole failing test at every point in this history is the identical, already-existing tools/review-watch/stage2-report.test.mjs module-load assertion against docs/stage2-audit-contract.md -- verified to fail identically at commit 149d8a1 (main, before any 454 commit), at 3750d27, and at the exact merge commit ddfcfa037c33c33634a88cf65d8fe841af38bdf6 -- a pre-existing defect outside this plan's scope, not a regression any 454 unit or the PR #459 correction pass introduced or is responsible for fixing.
